options_en: It can transfer any suit, appeal or other
It can withdraw any suit and appeal or other proceeding pending in any Court subordinate to it

It can try or dispose of the suit, appeal or other proceeding withdrawn from any Court subordinate to it or it may transfer the same for trial or disposal to some other Court subordinate to it and competent to try or dispose of the same
It cannot retransfer any suit, appeal or other proceeding to the Court from which it was withdrawn
options_hi: यह किसी भी मुकदमे, अपील या अन्य को स्थानांतरित कर सकता है

questions.explanation_en: Correct Answer: (D). It cannot retransfer any suit, appeal or other proceeding to the Court from which it was withdrawn.
